{{Liquipedia links|counterstrike=Laz}} {{for|the Thai player|Laz (Thai player)}} {{Player Coach Tabs}} {{Infobox player |id=Laz |image=2c Laz at VALORANT Challengers Japan 2026 Season Finals.jpg |birth_date=1995-11-26 |name=牛田 浩二 |romanized_name=Koji Ushida |country=Japan |team=ZETA DIVISION |roles=Streamer |mildom=10595261 |status=Active |years_active=2020 - 2024 |ids=Lazvell, Chester |web=https://lazvell.com/ |twitter=lazvell |youtube=lazvell |twitch=lazvell |instagram=laz.vl |history={{TeamHistoryAuto}} |retired=2024-08-26 }} {{PlayerIntroduction}} ==Biography== ===Early life=== Koji "Laz" Ushida was born in Yokohama, Japan and grew up in Tokyo. He got into playing first person shooting games when he was in junior high school, after his friends has invited him to play. Eventually the ''Counter-Strike'' series including [[:counterstrike:Counter-Strike: Global Offensive | Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]] drew his attention, where he found his confidence in his skills, before he started receiving invitation to teams and started to play in tournaments. ===Professional Counter Strike Career (2015-2020)=== [[:counterstrike:Laz|Laz]] spent most of his time during his ''CS:GO'' career with [[:counterstrike:Absolute|Absolute]]. He joined the team in the early days of the team and played under multiple names and organizations such as [[:counterstrike:Rascal_Jester_Absolute|Rascal Jester Absolute]] and [[:counterstrike:SCARZ_Absolute|SCARZ Absolute]]. One of his notable achievements in ''CS:GO'' was the top 8 finish at [[:counterstrike:WESG 2018|WESG 2018]]. [[:counterstrike:Absolute|Absolute]] was dominating Japan at the time, however the competitive ''CS:GO'' has been declining rapidly in his region and he suffered the disparity in the quality of their practice environment compare to the top teams in Asia and the rest of the world. [https://www.negitaku.org/news/n-23947] ===Professional VALORANT Career (2020-2024)=== Laz and [[:counterstrike:Absolute|Absolute]] announced their transition to ''VALORANT'' on March 2, 2020, the same day ''VALORANT'' was announced. On April, 2020, [[:counterstrike:Absolute|Absolute]] announced their contract with '''JUPITER''' and their new team name: [[Absolute JUPITER]]. Since the early days of ''VALORANT'' he has achieved excellence and proved himself as one of the best Japanese players. Although they have lost their throne during the 2021 season, right after the rebranding of '''JUPITER''' to '''ZETA DIVISION''' Laz reclaimed his title as the Japanese champion at the [[VALORANT_Champions_Tour/2021/Japan/Stage_3/Challengers_Playoffs|Stage 3 Challengers]]. However, after a poor showing at the [[VALORANT_Champions_Tour/2021/Stage_3/Masters|Masters Berlin]], [[ZETA DIVISION|ZETA]] decided to reorganize.
